capabilities: Search TMDB and add movies and shows as Markdown notes with YAML metadata
Browse and filter the title library in a grid view
Track episodes per show and fetch new seasons and episodes
Fetch country-specific streaming availability and provider logos
Compute viewing metrics such as top genres, actors, directors, and genre taste index
extras: The TMDB API key is free for non-commercial use and must be entered in settings. The author advises backing up the library before using the file update feature, and lists several caveats such as special characters in filenames and theme-switch reload issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog movies and TV shows with posters, ratings, episode tracking, and streaming availability.

relations.evidence: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

summary: Movie and TV show tracker that stores each title as a Markdown note and offers a library grid, discovery recommendations, and viewing metrics.
